name: reulay
description: Guided breathing, immersive experiences, reflections and mindset tracking from Reulay, inside ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Reset your mind in the chat
interface.longDescription:
Reulay is a mindset and wellbeing tool for everyday stress, focus and emotional resets. It helps you change the conversation you have with yourself. Tell ChatGPT how you feel in your own words ("big presentation in 10 minutes", "I can't switch off", "that meeting rattled me") and Reulay gives you the right reset, right in the chat.

What you can do:
- Reset in 60 seconds with a guided breathing exercise that runs in the chat (cyclic sighing, box, 4-7-8 or coherent breathing)
- Watch a short immersive Reulay experience matched to how you feel, shown as playable cards
- Prepare for a hard conversation: get clear on what you want, their side and your opening line
- Work through self-doubt: answer the doubt with evidence and a more balanced thought
- Take the Reulay Mindset Assessment and see your profile, strongest and weakest
- Read today's Reulay feed and brain-based tips with their research citations
- Follow Reulay journeys, short guided stories on mindset and the science behind it
- Talk to Cali, your Reulay coach, and see your recent sessions and streak

After an experience you can share how you feel, the same check-in as the Reulay app. Everything syncs with your Reulay account. Sign in with your Reulay account when you connect.

Reulay is an applied neuroscience company. Reulay is mindset and wellness training, not medical care.
defaultPrompt: I'm stressed, give me a 2-minute reset
Recommend something to help me focus
Help me prepare for a hard conversation

positive.description: Short breathing reset when the user says they are anxious
positive.prompt: @Reulay I'm anxious before a big presentation and have 2 minutes. Help me calm down.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the in-chat breathing guide with a 1 to 2 minute pattern such as cyclic sighing or box breathing, paced and animated.

positive.description: Recommend experiences and play one in the chat
positive.prompt: @Reulay Recommend something to cheer me up, then play the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows playable experience cards matched to the mood, then plays the chosen experience in the in-chat video player.

positive.prompt: @Reulay I finished the video. I feel a lot calmer now, about a 7 out of 9.
positive.expected_behavior: Records the check-in for the session just watched and confirms it was saved to the user's Reulay account.
Shows the interactive assessment; after the user answers, saves it and summarizes their mindset profile with strongest and weakest mindsets.

positive.prompt: @Reulay I have to give my manager hard feedback tomorrow. Help me prepare.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the difficult-conversation reflection, which walks through what the user wants, the other person's side and an opening line.

negative.description: Unrelated coding request should not use Reulay
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a linked list.

negative.description: Unrelated factual question should not use Reulay
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Medical emergency should not be handled with a wellness reset
negative.prompt: I have crushing chest pain and my left arm is numb.
